reason: Unreachable as written. Validation runs with RDFS inference and mira:instance_of declares rdfs:range mira:AssetClass, so the object of instance_of is inferred to be an AssetClass before the shape's sh:class check runs and the check can never fail. Instance-to-instance is still rejected, by AssetClassInstanceShape (fixture invalid/core_instance_of_another_instance.ttl). Instance-to-non-asset is NOT rejected by anything. Making the rule reachable means either validating without inference or dropping the range, and both change what every other shape sees, so it is a domain-rule decision and not a fixture.
